destination.title: Inflationary dynamics, perturbations and effective-theory limits
destination.question: How do inflationary dynamics, field content, symmetries, initial states and effective-theory assumptions shape primordial observables and the consistency of inflationary scenarios?
destination.summary: A broad navigation family connecting observable spectra and correlations to their dynamical and theoretical assumptions. General scalar-EFT consistency and a preceding self-reproducing phase remain accessible boundary directions.

systems: Single-field, single-clock and multifield inflation, distinguished source by source
Inflation with gauge fields, hidden species, modified kinetic terms or nonminimal couplings
Scalar effective theories with cosmological applications
targets: Background viability, power spectra, bispectra and conditional parameter inference
Initial-state dependence, symmetry restrictions and effective-description validity
Conditional compatibility with adopted quantum-gravity conjectures
regimes: Source-specific slow-roll, non-attractor and pre-inflationary phases
Boundary regimes: Lorentz-breaking scalar backgrounds, planar Minkowski caustics and self-reproduction
assumptions: Numerical membership is a retrieval proposal, not evidence of question equivalence
Quantum-gravity conjectures apply only where explicitly adopted
Ordinary and pre-Swampland inflationary work is eligible
conventions: Preserve source-specific Planck units, slow-roll definitions and evaluation epochs
Do not identify one inflating scalar with single-clock perturbations
Keep source-era observational bounds and forecasts dated
includes: Analytical calculations, reviews, numerical methods and phenomenological reconstruction
Alternate homes for sources extending beyond observable-era inflation
excludes: A universal consistency relation across all included systems
Established quantum-gravity restrictions or a current observational fit
Automatic equivalence of questions sharing an observable or method

sources.title: Mixed non-Gaussianity in multiple-DBI inflation

evidence.text: Can multiple-DBI inflation produce appreciable local and equilateral primordial bispectra simultaneously, and can evolution after horizon exit suppress the equilateral enhancement from small sound speeds?

sources.title: Non-Bunch–Davis initial state reconciles chaotic models with BICEP and Planck

evidence.text: Can scale-dependent non-Bunch–Davies initial states reconcile large-field chaotic inflation, especially the quadratic model, with the historical Planck and BICEP2 results through blue tensors or large negative scalar running?

sources.title: Just enough inflation: power spectrum modifications at large scales

evidence.text: How does a non-slow-roll epoch preceding only 50–60 e-foldings of observable slow-roll inflation modify the largest-scale primordial spectrum, and which features depend on equation of state, vacuum choice, or earlier pre-inflationary stages?

sources.title: Distinctive signatures of space-time diffeomorphism breaking in EFT of inflation

evidence.text: What observable signatures follow when inflation simultaneously breaks time and spatial diffeomorphisms, particularly through interactions between their scalar Goldstone modes and through new tensor couplings?

sources.title: Multi-field inflation and cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: Review how multiple inflaton fields generate cosmological perturbations, emphasizing field-space bases, gauge fixing, quadratic actions, power spectra, and nonlinear evolution.

sources.title: Bell violation in the Sky

evidence.text: Can additional fields with time-dependent masses support a cosmological Bell test, and can their fluctuation signatures constrain inflationary scales, tensor production and particle masses?

sources.title: Primordial fluctuations and non-Gaussianities in sidetracked inflation

evidence.text: If geometrical destabilization leads to a second inflationary attractor, what background dynamics, power spectra and primordial bispectra arise, and when can a single-field effective theory describe them?

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Can single-field inflation evade the apparent conflict between a steep positive potential and a small observed tensor signal by changing the initial quantum state of perturbations?

sources.title: Rescuing Single Field Inflation from the Swampland

evidence.text: Can excited perturbation initial states reconcile steep single-field inflation, conditional on the conjectured swampland gradient bound, with the historical Planck tensor and non-Gaussianity constraints?

sources.title: Generic 3-point statistics with tensor modes in light of Swampland and Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: Can excited inflationary initial states preserve potentially observable tensor three-point functions while accommodating the adopted quantum-gravity conjectures? The targets are the tensor auto-bispectrum and both scalar-tensor mixed bispectra.

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Use a phenomenological scalar-tilt attractor and reported scalar-amplitude and tensor-ratio summaries to calibrate inflationary reconstruction. The chosen evaluation epoch is N=60 and the source associates the modes with Hubble-radius crossing.

sources.title: Non-Gaussian features of primordial fluctuations in single field inflationary models

evidence.text: What are the leading non-Gaussian scalar and tensor three-point functions in single-field inflation, including their numerical coefficients, momentum dependence and squeezed limits? How are these calculations related to cosmological wavefunctions and hypothetical dS/CFT correlators?

sources.title: Ghost inflation

evidence.text: Can a ghost condensate drive inflation and trigger its end without a slow-roll potential, while generating calculable scalar perturbations and a distinctive primordial bispectrum?

sources.title: Mixed non-Gaussianity in multiple-DBI inflation

evidence.text: ADM expansion in spatially flat gauge isolates scalar field fluctuations. First-order lapse and shift constraints suffice for the cubic action; background equations and removal of total derivatives simplify the result.

sources.title: Non-Bunch–Davis initial state reconciles chaotic models with BICEP and Planck

evidence.text: The appendix summarizes the gauge-invariant Mukhanov–Sasaki equation and its leading slow-roll Hankel-function solutions. Scalar and tensor spectra are obtained by multiplying their BD spectra by initial-state factors γ_S and γ_T.

sources.title: Just enough inflation: power spectrum modifications at large scales

evidence.text: Use the Mukhanov–Sasaki variable u=zR, z=a√(2ε), and rewrite its equation in e-folding time for aH proportional to exp(ξN_e). Solve constant-ξ stages with Hankel functions for ξ≠0 and exponential solutions for ξ=0.

sources.title: Distinctive signatures of space-time diffeomorphism breaking in EFT of inflation

evidence.text: Correlation functions are calculated perturbatively with the in-in formalism, treating quadratic π–σ mixing as insertions and combining it with cubic interactions for bispectra. Free scalar mode functions use the Bunch–Davies choice.

sources.title: Multi-field inflation and cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: ADM decomposition identifies lapse and shift constraints; substituting their linear solutions gives quadratic actions. Hamiltonian analysis tests gauge fixing through the nonvanishing determinant of Poisson brackets between gauge conditions and constraints.

sources.title: Bell violation in the Sky

evidence.text: Reports in-in calculations of scalar one- and two-point functions. The decoherence discussion couples curvature fluctuations ζ to an environment G and traces over environmental states to discuss suppression of interference.

sources.title: Observational signatures and non-Gaussianities of general single field inflation

evidence.text: What determines the magnitude, momentum shape and running of the primordial scalar bispectrum in general single-field inflation, and can its shape diagnose a departure from the Bunch-Davies vacuum?

sources.title: Cosmic Microwave Background Observables of Small Field Models of Inflation

evidence.text: Can effective single-field inflation produce detectable tensors and substantial negative scalar running with a Planck-scale or smaller excursion, and do EFT consistency conditions connect the running to the inflationary energy scale?

sources.title: Resonant Non-Gaussianity

evidence.text: Calculate the primordial scalar bispectrum for arbitrary momentum triangles in canonical single-field inflation with small periodic potential modulations, and determine its mechanism, shape and distinguishability from commonly searched templates.

sources.title: Large and small field inflation from hyperbolic sigma models

evidence.text: Can one modular twofield model realize both large and small initial field values, provide sufficient inflation for a finite fraction of initial conditions, and connect CMB observables to target-space curvature?

sources.title: PyTransport: A Python package for the calculation of inflationary correlation functions

evidence.text: How can users automatically construct and run numerical calculations of inflationary power spectra and bispectra for specified multifield potentials and field-space metrics, including evolution before and after horizon crossing?

sources.title: Constraints from Conformal Symmetry on the Three Point Scalar Correlator in Inflation

evidence.text: How strongly do approximate conformal symmetry and slow roll constrain the leading nonzero scalar bispectrum, its magnitude, and its determination from a soft limit of the scalar four-point function?

sources.title: Primordial Gravitational Waves and the Swampland

evidence.text: Determine whether quantum-gravity conjectures can restrict primordial tensor amplitudes without excluding canonical single-field slow-roll inflation with roughly 60 e-folds. The paper focuses on how uncertain conjecture parameters affect this compatibility.

sources.title: Tensor Bounds on the Hidden Universe

evidence.text: Can gravitational loops of numerous hidden light fields produce observable tensor-spectrum corrections during single-clock inflation, allowing a detected primordial tensor spectrum to constrain hidden species through departures from the scalar–tensor consistency relation?

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: Determine whether discrete shift-containing symmetries at higher modular level can organize two-field inflationary potentials and preserve symmetry-compatible CMB observables despite differentiation of modular forms.

sources.title: Assisted inflation

evidence.text: Can multiple scalar fields with individually steep exponential potentials cooperate through cosmic expansion to produce inflation, and what scaling attractor and curvature-perturbation spectrum result when their slopes differ?

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can single-field inflation satisfy conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions on its potential while reproducing a small tensor-to-scalar ratio and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum?

sources.title: Consistency of EFT illuminated via relative entropy: a case study in scalar field theory

evidence.text: Can the sign of perturbatively calculated relative entropy diagnose failure of scalar EFT expansions, and what conditional restrictions does this impose on inflationary Wilson coefficients and the non-Gaussianity parameter fNL?

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: What perturbation initial data should an inflationary effective theory inherit from an unspecified earlier phase?

sources.title: Scaling attractors in multi-field inflation

evidence.text: Does the reported bifurcation pattern persist in less symmetric higher-dimensional field spaces, and how should exact scaling backgrounds be used to calculate observable fluctuation correlations?

sources.title: A new mechanism to enhance primordial tensor fluctuations in single field inflation

evidence.text: Can a brief non-attractor phase enhance primordial tensor fluctuations in single-field inflation by amplifying their would-be decaying mode, without introducing additional source fields?

sources.title: Gauge Fields and Inflation

evidence.text: How can gauge fields affect inflation through fluctuations, subdominant anisotropic backgrounds, or backgrounds driving isotropic expansion, and what magnetic-field, CMB, and gravitational-wave signatures can result?

sources.title: The Effective Theory of Shift-Symmetric Cosmologies

evidence.text: What model-independent restrictions does an exact internal scalar shift symmetry impose on single-clock cosmological EFT coefficients, their time dependence, interactions and adiabatic modes?

sources.title: Two‐Field Axion Inflation and the Swampland Constraint in the Flux‐Scaling Scenario

evidence.text: Can fractional and field-dependent effective coefficients arise microscopically while retaining stabilization and inflation?

sources.title: Low scale inflation

evidence.text: Can small-field inflation with a leading quadratic field dependence generate acceptable scalar perturbations at electroweak or lower energy scales, with viable initial conditions and controlled termination?

destination.title: Topological field theories, phases, symmetry constraints and applications
destination.question: How do topological field theories and generalized symmetries organize phases, boundaries, dualities, and quantum-information or holographic constructions?
destination.summary: A proposed navigational family with distinct physical questions and explicit neighboring topics. The original numerical collection has no supplied scientific scope statement; its membership alone cannot establish this interpretation. Differences in dimension or method do not themselves exclude a source, but shared words such as duality or anomaly do not establish membership either.

systems: Topological and partially topological field theories
Bosonic and fermionic phases, lattice models and topological quantum memories
targets: Construction and classification of theories and phases
Boundary existence, extended operators and anomaly constraints
Response diagnostics, protected operations and holographic ensembles
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, symmetry types and coupling regimes
Topological limits distinguished from dynamical bulk theories
Equilibrium phase questions distinguished from nonequilibrium neighbors
assumptions: No shared physical premise is inferred from numerical membership
Proposed classifications and open completeness questions retain their stated status
conventions: Spatial and spacetime dimensions retain their source meanings
Spin, non-spin, fractional-charge and operator conventions remain distinct
includes: Applications and methods with explicit contribution roles
Alternate access to neighboring questions outside the proposed core
excludes: Automatic equivalence of questions sharing a card
A universal gapped or topological regime for every source
Geometric S-duality, general code theory or chiral dynamics admitted solely by vocabulary

sources.title: Topological boundary conditions in abelian Chern-Simons theory

evidence.text: Describe topological boundaries, boundary and boundary-changing lines, and surface defects in abelian Chern–Simons theory; partially construct their higher categorical structure and classify quantum theories using invertible duality walls.

sources.title: Symmetry-protected topological phases with charge and spin symmetries: Response theory and dynamical gauge theory in two and three dimensions

evidence.text: How do charge/spin responses and partially gauged theories distinguish selected bosonic SPT phases, particularly a 3D bulk's anomalous surface from a strictly 2D SPT with the same remaining symmetry?

sources.title: Higher Symmetry and Gapped Phases of Gauge Theories

evidence.text: Which TQFTs describe gapped gauge phases with simultaneous partial Higgsing and confinement, how are their actions and extended observables classified, and can they describe phases protected by higher symmetry?

sources.title: Topological phases with generalized global symmetries

evidence.text: How can simple bosonic lattice models realize SPT phases protected by higher-form or mixed-form global symmetries, establish their nontriviality through quantum circuit criteria, and generate fault-tolerant logical gates?

sources.title: Gapped Boundary Phases of Topological Insulators via Weak Coupling

evidence.text: Can explicit weakly coupled models realize symmetry-preserving, topologically ordered gapped surfaces of an electron topological insulator while matching its boundary anomalies and spin/charge relation?

sources.title: Reflection positivity and invertible topological phases

evidence.text: How should reflection positivity extend to fully extended invertible topological field theories, and how can their deformation classes inform the classification of invertible lattice phases from dimension and symmetry type?

sources.title: Global 4-group symmetry and ’t Hooft anomalies in topological axion electrodynamics

evidence.text: Which higher-form symmetries and higher-group structure govern fully gapped (3+1)-dimensional axion electrodynamics, what obstructions arise when gauging them, and how do those structures explain bulk and domain-wall topological effects?

sources.title: Anomalies of non-invertible symmetries in (3+1)d

evidence.text: Which finite non-invertible symmetries in 3+1d obstruct symmetric invertible gapped phases, and which obstruct even symmetric topological phases? The focus is on additional anomalies carried by generalized Frobenius–Schur indicators beyond the permutation action on bulk excitations.

sources.title: Global Symmetries, Code Ensembles, and Sums over Geometries

evidence.text: How do additive codes and code CFTs arise from gauging global symmetries of 3d TQFTs, and can an ensemble of maximal gaugings be represented holographically by the original TQFT summed over geometries?

sources.title: Automorphism-weighted ensembles from TQFT gravity

evidence.text: What determines the boundary ensemble weights in the proposed duality between topology-summed 3d TQFT and Lagrangian condensations, and how should its topology sum and baby-universe Hilbert space be understood?

sources.title: Classification of Abelian spin Chern-Simons theories

evidence.text: When do distinct classical U(1)ᴺ spin Chern–Simons actions define equivalent quantum theories, which invariants classify them, and what does that classification imply for fractional quantum Hall response?

sources.title: Fault tolerant quantum computation by anyons

evidence.text: Can two-dimensional systems with local interactions protect quantum information physically and implement fault-tolerant computation through anyon braiding and fusion, without requiring an exact microscopic symmetry?

sources.title: Topological boundary conditions in abelian Chern-Simons theory

evidence.text: Monopole screening identifies Wilson lines; ribbon fusion and Aharonov–Bohm transport determine associators and braidings. Pentagon, hexagon, and boundary hexagon relations organize the resulting categorical consistency conditions.

sources.title: Symmetry-protected topological phases with charge and spin symmetries: Response theory and dynamical gauge theory in two and three dimensions

evidence.text: Long-wavelength response uses L=ΘIJ ε^{μνλρ}∂μAIν∂λAJρ/(8π²), with symmetric Θ having diagonal θc, θs and off-diagonal θ0. Flux insertion, exchange statistics and deposition of 2D Hall layers determine allowed responses and angle periodicities.

sources.title: Higher Symmetry and Gapped Phases of Gauge Theories

evidence.text: Topological actions are analyzed through the Serre spectral sequence of the classifying-space fibration. Four-dimensional quadratic terms use the Pontryagin square; with nonzero β the text says closure occurs only after applying q*, rather than for PB itself.

sources.title: Topological phases with generalized global symmetries

evidence.text: The m-qubit controlled phase gate multiplies a computational-basis state by (−1)^(x₁⋯x_m). Conjugating a Pauli X decorates it with a lower-body controlled phase. Applying these gates simplex by simplex constructs H₁=UH₀U† from a product-state Hamiltonian.

sources.title: Gapped Boundary Phases of Topological Insulators via Weak Coupling

evidence.text: Radial quantization on R × S² determines monopole quantum numbers. The Callias index theorem and quantization of fermion zero modes organize vortex states; Clifford-algebra transformations describe their braiding.

sources.title: Reflection positivity and invertible topological phases

evidence.text: Model invertible theories by spectrum maps from Σ^n MT H_n, where MT H_n=Thom(BH_n;−V_n). Character-dual targets track discrete theories, Anderson-dual targets track deformation information, and Borel Z/2-equivariant homotopy theory implements reflection.

sources.title: Coupling a QFT to a TQFT and Duality

evidence.text: How does coupling an ordinary QFT to a TQFT change observables, sums over topological sectors, global gauge-group structure, and the precise formulation of duality on compact spaces?

sources.title: Topological Chern-Simons/Matter Theories

evidence.text: Can Chern–Simons theory be coupled to dynamical matter while retaining metric independence through a transverse holomorphic foliation, and can its action and partition function be understood through branes and a partially topological N=2 twist?

sources.title: Higher central charges and topological boundaries in 2+1-dimensional TQFTs

evidence.text: Beyond vanishing chiral central charge, which computable invariants obstruct a gapped boundary of a bosonic 2+1-dimensional TQFT, and when do higher central charges give a complete criterion?

sources.title: Chern-Simons Theory and Wilson Loops in the Brillouin Zone

evidence.text: Can pairing fluctuations in three-dimensional time-reversal-invariant superconductors produce a fluctuating Berry gauge field governed by Brillouin-zone Chern–Simons theory, with nodal lines acting as Wilson loops that modify the gravitational theta response?

sources.title: IIB string theory explored: Reflection 7-branes

evidence.text: Which localized degrees of freedom account for nonzero Chern-Simons inflow at the smooth cigar core?

sources.title: Short-range entanglement and invertible field theories

evidence.text: Can long-range invertible field theories provide invariants of interacting bosonic and fermionic short-range entangled phases that detect phases beyond group cohomology?

sources.title: Global anomalies on the surface of fermionic symmetry-protected topological phases in (3+1) dimensions

evidence.text: Can global gauge and gravitational anomalies of symmetry-projected surface fermions diagnose (3+1)d fermionic SPT phases and interaction-induced reductions of their non-interacting classifications?

sources.title: Duality origami: Emergent ensemble symmetries in holography and Swampland

evidence.text: What microscopic bulk description retains the moduli dependence erased by averaging? The paper uses Maxwell–Chern–Simons theory on fixed topology, with a dimensionful Maxwell coupling and dimensionless kinetic matrix.

sources.title: SymTh for non-finite symmetries

evidence.text: Can a weakly coupled, non-topological bulk symmetry theory encode a boundary QFT's non-finite generalized symmetries, including non-flat backgrounds, dynamical gauging, anomalies and non-invertible defects?

sources.title: Fractional $S$-duality, Classification of Fractional Topological Insulators and Surface Topological Order

evidence.text: Which electromagnetic dualities and time-reversal-invariant axion angles are compatible with fractional bulk charge, and how do stacking and surface topological order distinguish fractional topological insulators?

sources.title: Giant nonlocal edge conduction in the axion insulator state of MnBi2Te4

evidence.text: Does the low-field axion-insulator state of even-septuple-layer MnBi2Te4 support one-dimensional edge conduction, and can nonlocal transport distinguish the proposed counterpropagating hinge currents from bulk transport and alternative edge mechanisms?

sources.title: Anomalies of discrete symmetries in three dimensions and group cohomology

evidence.text: Can bosonic theories in three spacetime dimensions have anomalous finite internal symmetries, and can gauging one factor of a discrete product symmetry necessarily break the other?

sources.title: Boundary Conditions and Unitarity: the Maxwell-Chern-Simons System in $AdS_3/CFT_2$

evidence.text: Which boundary conditions conserve the symplectic structure of Maxwell–Chern–Simons theory in asymptotically AdS3, and which survive bulk ghost and boundary unitarity tests, including conditions coupling massive modes to chiral currents?

sources.title: Chern-Simons theory with finite gauge group

evidence.text: Construct a mathematically explicit finite-gauge-group topological field theory from its classical action through path-integral quantization, retaining locality, automorphisms, boundary state spaces, and gluing.

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Generalized Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory and Beyond

evidence.text: How do generalized global symmetries and their anomalies constrain QFT dynamics, especially renormalization group flows, confinement, and possible infrared phases?

sources.title: Generalized Global Symmetries

evidence.text: Formulate higher-form global symmetries intrinsically through extended operators, and determine their consequences for selection rules, gauging, duality, spontaneous breaking, anomalies and phases of quantum field theory.

sources.title: Non-invertible global symmetries and completeness of the spectrum

evidence.text: Which magnetic distinctions can topological operators detect, and which depend on a finer convention for ’t Hooft lines?

sources.title: Anyon condensation in Virasoro TQFT: wormhole factorization

evidence.text: Can diagonal anyon condensation restore two-boundary wormhole factorization in Virasoro TQFT despite its continuous Wilson-line spectrum, and identify the resulting boundary theory?

sources.title: TQFT gravity and ensemble holography

evidence.text: What bulk mechanism relates a topology-summed three-dimensional TQFT to an ensemble of two-dimensional CFTs, and how does it determine ensemble weights and contributing topology classes without explicitly evaluating partition functions?

sources.title: Symmetry protected topological orders and the group cohomology of their symmetry group

evidence.text: How can interacting bosonic SPT phases in d spatial dimensions be constructed and labeled using the symmetry group's cohomology, including antiunitary symmetries, and what boundary behavior follows?

sources.title: A symmetry principle for topological quantum order

evidence.text: Which symmetry conditions ensure topological quantum order (TQO), understood as robustness against quasi-local perturbations, at zero and finite temperature? Which commonly associated diagnostics are insufficient?

sources.title: $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Lattice Gerbe Theory

evidence.text: What phase structure follows for Z2 lattice gerbe theories from their identification with generalized Ising models, including dimensional dependence, Wilson-surface scaling and dualities with or without an external field?

sources.title: Symmetry TFTs and anomalies of non-invertible symmetries

evidence.text: Can computable linking invariants in a Symmetry TFT diagnose obstructions to gauging finite non-invertible symmetries and constrain infrared dynamics?

sources.title: Generalized Symmetries in Condensed Matter

evidence.text: Can generalized symmetries together with their anomalies extend the Landau paradigm to encompass all equilibrium quantum phases and their transitions? The review presents this as a productive open question.

sources.title: Anomalies of discrete symmetries in various dimensions and group cohomology

evidence.text: When can discrete global-symmetry anomalies in bosonic gauge theories be canceled by Dijkgraaf–Witten inflow, how are their cohomology classes calculated, and when do more severe obstructions occur?

sources.title: Z(N) gauge theories on a lattice and quantum memory

evidence.text: How do lattice Z_N gauge theories realize Kitaev-type quantum memory, and how do electric fluctuations and static versus time-dependent random gauge couplings affect its stability?
